cves.description: cf-manager is an all-in-one dashboard for managing multiple Cloudflare accounts and services. Prior to 1.1.2, worker/src/routes/workers.ts uses bare fetch(url) calls to retrieve user-supplied URLs and deploys the returned content as a Worker script using stored Cloudflare credentials. The multipart and JSON branches of POST /api/:accountId/workers and POST /api/batch-deploy accept URLs without protocol, destination, redirect, content-type, or response-size validation. An attacker with deployment API access, or unauthenticated access when API_SECRET is not configured, can make cf-manager access internal resources or fetch attacker-controlled JavaScript and execute it in the victim Cloudflare Workers account. This issue is fixed in version 1.1.2.
cves.fix_suggestion:
📦 受影响组件：hefy2027 cf-manager
🔓 漏洞类型：Code Injection, Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) (CWE-94, CWE-918)
🛠️ 修复建议：
1. 确认受影响的版本范围（见上方 Affected Products）
2. 升级到厂商官方发布的最稳定安全版本
3. 检查官方安全公告获取补丁链接
4. 如无法立即升级，实施临时缓解措施：
   - 网络层：WAF 规则 / IPS 签名 / 零信任策略
   - 主机层：最小化暴露面 / 禁用危险功能 / 输入过滤
5. 修复后使用 NVD / 厂商 PoC 验证修复有效性
problemType: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code

cves.description: Fleet before 4.86.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust server memory through quadratic XML canonicalization of unsigned SAML responses. Attackers can send a single crafted SAML response with deeply nested elements declaring new namespace prefixes to POST /api/v1/fleet/sso/callback, crashing the Fleet server.

cves.description: The Datadog Agent collects events and metrics from hosts and sends them to Datadog. Prior to datadog-apm-inject 0.66.0, the Datadog Single Step Instrumentation injector stores helper tooling in a predictable host directory. On Linux or Kubernetes systems with SSI enabled and at least one Java service instrumented through SSI, a local unprivileged attacker with shell access to the same host can influence that tooling and execute code with the privileges of the instrumented Java service. Services that use dd-java-agent without SSI and non-Java language runtimes are not affected. This issue is fixed in datadog-apm-inject 0.66.0.

cves.description: Miren Runtime provides the runtime component for the Miren application platform. Prior to 0.11.1, the QUIC/HTTP3 RPC server on the default port 8443 uses tls.RequestClientCert and does not verify that presented certificates chain to the configured cluster certificate authority. The RPC authenticators derive a caller identity from PeerCertificates[0].Subject.CommonName without requiring a non-empty VerifiedChains value, and certificate identities bypass all RBAC checks. A network attacker who can reach the listener can present a self-signed certificate with an issuer distinguished name matching the public cluster CA subject and gain cluster superuser access, allowing disclosure, modification, or disruption of applications, sandboxes, disks, credentials, and other managed resources. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.1.
